secrets.name: CONTACT_NOTIFICATION_EMAIL
secrets.description: Optional. Address that should receive contact-form notifications. Without it, submissions are still stored in the database.

secrets.name: SMTP_HOST
secrets.description: Optional. SMTP relay host used to email contact-form notifications.

secrets.name: SMTP_USER
secrets.description: Optional. SMTP username for the relay.

secrets.name: SMTP_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Optional. SMTP password or API key for the relay.

secrets.name: SMTP_FROM
secrets.description: Optional. From address used on notification emails.
